description: This file defines the SyncResultStatus class which encapsulates the status of synchronization operations, indicating success or failure for pull and push actions within the context of the Android Nextcloud Notes client.

classes.name: SyncResultStatus
classes.description: Represents the result status of synchronization, including success indicators for pull and push operations.

methods.name: SyncResultStatus
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the status indicators to successful by default.
